# PR #2984: Patch: seeded random walks play whole dungeon runs and check that every fight starts and every count stays in bounds

Closes #2979

Work is complete and all checks are green; the release-build `spec check` was still running when this message was written, so this report covers everything observed. Final verification of that one command is left to CI (it only validates ruling-note cross-references; this change adds no ruling).

What changed and why: the dungeon run's tests walked one fixed path, so a run could grow its deck past what a game accepts without any test noticing. New `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs` plays `WALK_SEEDS` (25) whole runs per content (placeholder and catalog), drawing random actions and fight results from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk. Supporting changes: 9 test-only `WALK_*` constants in `src/config.rs`, 3 helpers in `src/fight_tests.rs` made `pub(crate)`, one `mod walk_tests;` line in `src/lib.rs`, one README sentence.

- `cargo test -p jackioh-run` — 40 passed, 0 failed, ~2.5–3.4s (walks alone 2.2s at 25 seeds; 9.9s at the planned 100, hence the tuning).

- `WALK_SEEDS = 25`, not 100: catalog engine setups cost ~50ms/walk; 100 seeds blew the few-seconds budget (rejected: slower suite).

# #2979: Patch: seeded random walks play whole dungeon runs and check that every fight starts and every count stays in bounds
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The dungeon run's tests walk one fixed path: always the first node, every fight won, heal at every campfire, leave every shop, walk away from every event. Shops, removals, events, curses and most artifact paths are tested one screen at a time, never as a whole run. That is how a run could grow its deck past what a game accepts, so that a later fight could never start, a fault the one fixed path never reached. Once built, a test plays a few hundred whole runs with random choices and random fight results, and fails if any fight cannot start, a run gets stuck on a screen, a number goes out of bounds, or the saved run does not replay to the same place.

## Why
- `crates/run/src/tests.rs:37-70`: `autoplay` "always takes the first node, wins every fight at 20 HP, ... leaves shops, heals at campfires, walks away from events". `a_run_played_to_the_end_wins_and_its_file_folds_back_to_the_same_state` (line 260) is the only whole-run test: one path, one seed.
- R2701000 (`crates/run/src/fight_tests.rs:443`): "A run that grew its deck past it would reach a fight it cannot start", the kind of fault a walk is built to find.
- `crates/tools` has no run mode (`jackioh-run` appears there only in the purity test), and the fuzz gate plays only games.
- Much of the run is still moving: its numbers are strawmen to be tuned (`crates/run/src/config.rs`) and the designer's content will replace `placeholder.json` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:50-55`), and each change shifts which paths a run reaches.

## Proposal
A test module in `crates/run`, pure (its choices drawn from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk, CLAUDE.md rule 4). For each of a named number of seeds, on both the placeholder content and the catalog's (`run_catalog_content`), it:
- picks at each phase a random action of that phase's kinds with random indices (a column, a buy, a removal, Radiant, a buff, a level, an event option, a kept subset, a blessing, leave), and reports a random fight result, mostly won at a random HP and sometimes lost, logging what was accepted;
- checks after every accepted step: HP between 1 and `run_max_hp` while the run lives, Coins and Tickets never negative, the deck within `RUN_DECK_MAX` with no card twice and no artifact twice (§15.2: nothing deals a card the deck holds; §15.3; §15.4: no run holds an artifact twice), and artifact levels within `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`;
- at every fight, builds `run_fight_setup` and checks the engine's `begin_game` starts it, curses and Combat artifacts included (R2922001);
- checks that no phase is a dead end (its free way on is accepted) and that every walk ends within a bound;
- folds the log with `run_fold` and checks it reaches the walk's end state.

## Where it lands
A new test module in `crates/run/src/`, beside `tests.rs` and `fight_tests.rs`, and `crates/run/README.md`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The walks run inside `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds, on both contents.
- [ ] Letting a pack keep past `RUN_DECK_MAX` makes the walk test fail.
- [ ] Each invariant fails when broken on purpose, or is shown failing on a hand-built state.
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed with its ruling in the issue's block.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

## Size and risks
Medium: one test module, 200 to 300 lines. A walk that tries random indices may rarely reach a narrow path (a shop the run can afford); weighting the picks toward actions the phase can pay for keeps coverage up. A real fault found would grow the patch.

13. `crates/run/README.md`, Tests paragraph: append one sentence, e.g. "`src/walk_tests.rs` walks whole seeded runs on both contents, checking bounds, fight setups and replay."

## Tests

All in `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs`; run with `cargo test -p jackioh-run walk`:

- `walks_play_whole_runs_in_bounds_start_every_fight_and_replay`: for tags `placeholder` (engine: false) and `catalog` (engine: true), `n` in `0..WALK_SEEDS`, run `walk` (includes per-step bounds, per-fight engine start on catalog, dead-end and step-bound checks, fold-to-same-state). After both loops assert every non-terminal phase (`Map`, `Fight`, `Reward`, `Pack`, `ExtractCard`, `ExtractArtifact`, `Shop`, `Campfire`, `Event`, `Shrine`) was visited at least once per content; with ~81% full-win probability per walk, `ExtractArtifact` is reached.

- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-run walk` (time it; raise/lower `WALK_SEEDS` so the whole `cargo test -p jackioh-run` stays a few seconds), then `cargo test -p jackioh-run`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` only if step 12 added a ruling.

## Done when

- [ ] Walks run in `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds on both contents.
- [ ] A pack kept past `RUN_DECK_MAX` fails the walk (step-11 probe observed and reported; hand-built over-max test in tree).
- [ ] Every invariant has a hand-built failing state in tree (or the failure shown).
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed, with its ruling in the 2979 block when the spec did not decide it.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant; `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

## Risks

- Walk rng vs run rng: two streams could hide nondeterminism; avoided by fixing the walk seed per `(tag, n)` and folding only the accepted log, which must equal the end state.

- Catalog walks cost `register_all` + full-deck `validate_setup`/`begin_game` per fight; if seconds blow out, lower `WALK_SEEDS` before touching coverage, and say so.
- Placeholder events guarantee a zero-cost option today; `free_action` scans for it rather than hardcoding index 2, so designer content without one fails loudly instead of hanging.
- Shop visits could take many accepted steps (each buy/spend is progress); `WALK_MAX_STEPS` at 5000 only trips on a true loop.
- Purity (rule 4): only `Rng`, `run_*` functions and phase data; no banned collections, clock, or I/O; the new module falls under `crates/run/clippy.toml` automatically.

## Open questions

None. Tuning (`WALK_SEEDS`, loss/way-on rates) is a strawman the builder sets from the measured time, per §15.13.

Plan is delivered above; I recorded the observed timing (whole-run test: 0.02s) in `.bot-plan.md` to support the `WALK_SEEDS = 100` starting value.

## What it actually means
The dungeon run's tests walk one fixed path: always the first node, every fight won, heal at every campfire, leave every shop, walk away from every event. Shops, removals, events, curses and most artifact paths are tested one screen at a time, never as a whole run. That is how a run could grow its deck past what a game accepts, so that a later fight could never start, a fault the one fixed path never reached. Once built, a test plays a few hundred whole runs with random choices and random fight results, and fails if any fight cannot start, a run gets stuck on a screen, a number goes out of bounds, or the saved run does not replay to the same place.

## Why
- `crates/run/src/tests.rs:37-70`: `autoplay` "always takes the first node, wins every fight at 20 HP, ... leaves shops, heals at campfires, walks away from events". `a_run_played_to_the_end_wins_and_its_file_folds_back_to_the_same_state` (line 260) is the only whole-run test: one path, one seed.
- R2701000 (`crates/run/src/fight_tests.rs:443`): "A run that grew its deck past it would reach a fight it cannot start", the kind of fault a walk is built to find.
- `crates/tools` has no run mode (`jackioh-run` appears there only in the purity test), and the fuzz gate plays only games.
- Much of the run is still moving: its numbers are strawmen to be tuned (`crates/run/src/config.rs`) and the designer's content will replace `placeholder.json` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:50-55`), and each change shifts which paths a run reaches.

## Proposal
A test module in `crates/run`, pure (its choices drawn from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk, CLAUDE.md rule 4). For each of a named number of seeds, on both the placeholder content and the catalog's (`run_catalog_content`), it:
- picks at each phase a random action of that phase's kinds with random indices (a column, a buy, a removal, Radiant, a buff, a level, an event option, a kept subset, a blessing, leave), and reports a random fight result, mostly won at a random HP and sometimes lost, logging what was accepted;
- checks after every accepted step: HP between 1 and `run_max_hp` while the run lives, Coins and Tickets never negative, the deck within `RUN_DECK_MAX` with no card twice and no artifact twice (§15.2: nothing deals a card the deck holds; §15.3; §15.4: no run holds an artifact twice), and artifact levels within `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`;
- at every fight, builds `run_fight_setup` and checks the engine's `begin_game` starts it, curses and Combat artifacts included (R2922001);
- checks that no phase is a dead end (its free way on is accepted) and that every walk ends within a bound;
- folds the log with `run_fold` and checks it reaches the walk's end state.

## Where it lands
A new test module in `crates/run/src/`, beside `tests.rs` and `fight_tests.rs`, and `crates/run/README.md`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The walks run inside `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds, on both contents.
- [ ] Letting a pack keep past `RUN_DECK_MAX` makes the walk test fail.
- [ ] Each invariant fails when broken on purpose, or is shown failing on a hand-built state.
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed with its ruling in the issue's block.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

## Size and risks
Medium: one test module, 200 to 300 lines. A walk that tries random indices may rarely reach a narrow path (a shop the run can afford); weighting the picks toward actions the phase can pay for keeps coverage up. A real fault found would grow the patch.
